content.value: An e-commerce platform sells a wide range of products and manages user interactions. (10) [CO1] Design a class hierarchy for the e-commerce platform. Include a base class ‘Product’ and at least three derived classes (Electronics', ‘Clothing', Book'). Explain how inheritance is used in your design to promote code reuse and extensibility.
